description: Search OS Open Names in Great Britain using your own vaulted OS Data Hub project key (provider os). OGL v3; names are not full postal addresses. Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Requires a TerraMCP Bearer key from https://terramcp.earth/account and your own vaulted OS Data Hub project key.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return; bounded by this tool's schema.

query.description: Place name to search in OS Open Names; not a full postal address.

name: os_names
